```yaml
name: Upgrade Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  upgrade-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install npm dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Prettier linting
        run: npm run lint:prettier

      - name: Run style contract linting
        run: npm run lint:style-contract

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          if [ -f bin/setup-python-deps ]; then
            bash bin/setup-python-deps
          fi

      - name: Run Bootstrap compatibility tests
        run: bash test/integration_bootstrap_compat.sh

      - name: Run Distill integration tests
        run: bash test/integration_distill.sh

      - name: Run Upgrade CLI tests
        run: bash test/integration_upgrade_cli.sh

      - name: Shellcheck shell scripts
        uses: luizm/action-sh-checker@883217215b11c1fabbf00eb1a9a041f62d74c744
        with:
          sh_checker_exclude: "test/integration_distill.sh"
          sh_checker_comment: true

      - name: Notify Slack on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: failure
          message: "Upgrade check failed for ${{ github.sha }}"
```
